data.name: Hike to Upper Yosemite Falls
data.description: On this private, guided hike to Yosemite Falls, you’ll climb from the valley floor to the top of North America’s tallest waterfall! This hike blends adventure, beauty, and the thrill of accomplishment in reaching one of Yosemite’s most stunning views.

meeting_point.address: Kiosk at Yosemite Falls Parking Lot, Yosemite, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Packing List:**
• Sun Hat
• Sunglasses
• Water Bottle (2L per person)
• Sunscreen
• Bug spray
• Raincoat & Warm Layer

**Optional:**
• Cash, to tip your guide!

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, snacks and lunch!*
